title: 3947 NORTH FREDONIA DRIVE; BOARD FILE NO. 260069
text:
[C. PUBLIC NUISANCE HEARINGS regarding the abatement of vacant buildings or structures that are]
3947 NORTH FREDONIA DRIVE; BOARD FILE NO. 260069
  C.D.: 4 (Councilmember Nithya Raman); Sherman Oaks – Studio City – Toluca Lake – Cahuenga
  Pass Planning Area

  STAFF MEMBER:  Zeydi Stewart
  BUREAU/DIVISION:  Code Enforcement/Vacant Building Abatement

  OWNER:  Drail Investment LLC – c/o Ron Fattal

  SUBJECT:

  The Department of Building and Safety (LADBS) requests that the Board of Building and
  Safety Commissioners (BBSC) determine that the subject property, consisting of a one-story,
  single family-dwelling with a detached garage, constitutes a public nuisance due to the property
  having been repeatedly breached and continuously maintained in an unsecured condition, thereby
  facilitating unauthorized entry and occupancy.

  ACTION BY THE BBSC IS NOT APPEALABLE.
summary: Public nuisance hearing regarding property at 3947 North Fredonia Drive, Sherman Oaks, where the building has been repeatedly breached and maintained in an unsecured condition.
